data.name: Clinics: WhatsApp patient desk + appointment booking (Gujarat)
data.budget_note: About 0.2 USD a day of Apify from the daily lead run. No paid sends yet.
data.segment: Doctor-owned clinics (dentist, skin / cosmetic, hair, physio) in Mehsana, Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar that already pay for Meta click-to-WhatsApp ads or take bookings on WhatsApp and phone
data.offer: WhatsApp patient desk for doctor-owned clinics: a first reply to each enquiry in about a minute with a booking slot to choose, a reminder before the appointment, a 6-month recall and a review request. We set everything up; the doctor spends about 10 minutes once. Prices are never quoted in the first message.
evidence_methods: Meta Ad Library: active clinic ads with a WhatsApp button (they pay for enquiries, so a slow reply or a no-show costs them money)
Google Maps: the clinic's own listing with a published phone number and reviews (owner-run, not a chain)
Job posts for a receptionist or telecaller (a sign the front desk is overloaded)
data.design_pack: Light Claude-style reel theme (cream paper with squares, orange accent); the clinic version uses a clinic chat mock
data.rules: Nothing is sent without the owner's OK. WhatsApp 1:1 from a human to the doctor's published number only; never email; never a bot or auto-greeting number; no fake patient enquiries; no price in the first message; one first touch and one follow-up on day 3; STOP is final. A website is NOT the pitch (owner: patients in India do not choose a clinic from its website).
data.validation_plan: 7-day test: 30 clinics, up to 10 personalised first touches a day. First touch = one line + one image of a sample chat for that clinic + a one-word reply. Success = at least 3 replies or taps in 7 days. Zero by day 7 = switch to coaching institutes. Compare reply rate by clinic type (dental / skin / physio).

waves.rule: active Meta ad with a WhatsApp button + a doctor-direct number; one touch, follow-up on day 3
only after the wave-1 reply rate is known

milestones.label: Campaign created: product changed from website to a WhatsApp patient desk (owner decision)
Daily lead agent retargeted to this campaign (doctor-direct WhatsApp number required)
7-day checkpoint: replies / taps vs the success rule
